QuestInfo.name: Those Who Leave, Those Who Start Again
QuestInfo.2:
Those students who survived the attack have lost their abilities! 
Some despaired at the loss of what they've dedicated their lives to and left in shame, though some remained, despite everything, to help. 

What Feng said shocked you to the core. What were the intruders looking for in the Xuanshan School? Why was Yun Wu working for them, and could he have been the one behind the poison...?
